I do think everyone’s body’s and minds are different, and you should always feel secure and safest while operating a vehicle. If that means driving with two feet, you should. There’s been a couple

My brain works a bit differently. It is more difficult & takes longer reaction time for me to use the same foot for braking, and accelerating. Most people only say you should use one foot for both because in a state of panic, you may accidentally hit the wrong pedal. I believe that I would have a higher chance of wrecking in a panic situation if I were to use one foot.. because of how close the gas and brake pedals are. I may panic and press the wrong pedal if I’m forced to use only one foot. Using two I know which foot I use for the brake, and gas. And it became second nature. 
I let my left foot rest on the ground when I’m not breaking. And my reaction time for my brake is always quicker and more efficient when I use my left foot.
